title: QA( Manual + Automation )
description:
**What's the work?**

Love finding bugs before they cause trouble? Passionate about making software smooth and reliable? Then this role is for you!

At Saleshandy, we're on a mission to achieve 100% automation by the end of the year - and we need you to help us get there! As our Junior QA Engineer, you'll test features, automate workflows, and work with developers to keep our products running flawlessly.

**Who Are We Looking For? - SDET 1**  
  

* 1-2 years of hands-on experience in QA / SDET role
* Strong understanding of web application testing, REST API testing, and API workflows
* Knowledge of SDLC, STLC, Agile methodologies, and test design techniques
* 1-2 years of hands-on experience with Playwright for test automation.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript
* Experience in building and maintaining automation frameworks using:
* BDD (Behavior-Driven Development) approach (e.g., Cucumber with Playwright)
* Page Object Model (POM)
* Ability to write clean, scalable, and maintainable automation scripts
* Experience integrating automation tests with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.)
* Hands-on experience in API testing using Postman
* Comfortable writing and validating SQL queries (MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.)
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git, GitHub, GitLab)
* Exposure to AI-powered testing tools and practices, such as:
* Using ChatGPT / GitHub Copilot for test generation
* Self-healing automation and intelligent locators
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Good communication and collaboration skills
* Ability to take ownership and work in a fast-paced environment

  
**Nice to have:**  

* Knowledge of performance testing (JMeter)
* Knowledge of security testing (OWASP Top 10)
